summary:
I received the copies of Limbo, and WOW WHAT A PRINTING JOB! What a professional classy look ... congratulations. No mimeo here. Thank you. How exciting to see—eventually—my Vancouver speech so well printed. 
However ... I’ll speak plainly. Fanzines never can print photos well. Your photos (what is it done by, photo-offset?) are superb, as good as contact prints. I wish to ask you a favor. Please, could you print a picture of me along with the speech; could you? (And of course you may reprint my old article “Schizophrenia and the Book of Changes,” as you requested ... but this photo, this is my recipro­ cal request. I would say, and in true candor, that the nude shot on page 3 of Limbo Nr. 4 is far superior to books such as Playboy. Any chance you should send me an enlargement of it? If it [?], the printed photo will do; it is breathtak­ ing, and shows the natural warm beauty of the human body, arousing no evil thoughts ... I’m sure you know what I mean. It is a beautiful girl beautifully pho­ tographed; it is, in fact, and [sic] good reason for shedding much of our clothing (as, by the way Ted Sturgeon and his wife do—they are nudists). Next question: is this the same girl, on page 8 of nr2? Kindly do this for me, Jannick, in any case: please tell her she’s super lovely, and I’ve seen a lot of attractive chicks but the photos of her make her look as if she might have in her something of what Garbo had ... you ought to call Goran Bengtson’s attention to her, since he is a big...
